title: JmapResponse missing createdIds field required by RFC 8620 §3.4
description: RFC 8620 §3.4 requires a createdIds map in every JMAP response. kith-core JmapResponse struct and kith-jmap Dispatcher.dispatch() never populate or serialize createdIds. For Foo/set create operations, clients relying on createdIds to map client-assigned creation IDs to server-assigned IDs will not work. The field is optional when empty, but must be present for any response that contains created objects.
